body:
# Mooshrooms Aren't Cows

Mooshrooms are NOT cows! When you shear a mooshroom, it stays a mooshroom - just without its mushrooms for a while. Like sheep, the mushrooms will grow back - but only if they eat mycelium!

## Features

### Shearing Behavior
- Shearing mooshrooms drops mushrooms but doesn't convert them to cows
- Mushrooms regrow when mooshrooms eat mycelium (like sheep eating grass)
- Brown and red mooshrooms keep their color identity
- Killing a mooshroom drops beef, leather, AND mushrooms

### Red Mooshroom Aggression
- Red mooshrooms become aggressive when attacked
- They will chase and attack the player who hurt them
- Their attacks inflict poison and nausea
- Aggression wears off after 10 seconds

### Configurable
All features can be customized in the config file:
- Toggle between mycelium-eating or timer-based mushroom regrowth
- Enable/disable red mooshroom aggression
- Adjust damage, effect durations, and amplifiers

## Configuration

The config file is located at `config/mooshroomsarentcows-common.toml`

| Option | Description | Default |
|--------|-------------|---------|
| `requireMyceliumForRegrowth` | Mooshrooms must eat mycelium to regrow mushrooms | `true` |
| `timerRegrowthTicks` | Ticks until regrowth (if timer-based) | `2400` |
| `redMooshroomsAggressive` | Red mooshrooms become aggressive when hit | `true` |
| `aggressiveDamage` | Damage dealt by aggressive mooshrooms | `3.0` |
| `aggressiveDuration` | Aggression duration in ticks | `200` |
| `aggressiveAppliesPoison` | Attacks apply poison | `true` |
| `poisonDuration` | Poison duration in ticks | `100` |
| `poisonAmplifier` | Poison level (0 = I, 1 = II, etc.) | `0` |
| `aggressiveAppliesNausea` | Attacks apply nausea | `true` |
| `nauseaDuration` | Nausea duration in ticks | `140` |
